system.description:
Crystallised Warp energy that only sorcery can shape, porcelain-like yet tougher than steel and self-repairing; spells flow across its surface, so its pieces are usually smooth, single curved forms. It follows the general magical-material rules (counts as Best, one hearthstone slot, magical damage).

Melee weapons can deliver melee-range spells using the weapon skill and Level instead of Brawl, and a spell of half an action or longer can include an attack with the weapon; ranged weapons reload themselves completely each time your turn begins; special ammunition is a magical attack that ignores Armor and is reduced by Aura instead; armour AP also counts as Aura against spells. A bionic arm can parry Touch or Ranged Touch spells aimed at you and, if the parry succeeds, absorbs the spell and any combo; bionic legs let you walk on air at full speed in three dimensions for one scene once per session; a bionic heart lets you roll Psychic Phenomena twice and pick the result.
system.effectText: Melee delivers touch spells; ranged self-refills ammo; ammo is magical (Aura instead of AP); armour AP also counts as Aura.
